summary.zh: 把 DSH 的私有协议翻译成手机客户端的双向帧与 REST 接口，并在设置页里提供配对、外网隧道与设备管理；dsh-Go 里带一块只读的「接入」面板和输入区状态条。
summary.en: Translates DSH's private protocol into bidirectional WebSocket frames and REST for mobile clients, with pairing, tunnels and device management in the settings page; includes a read-only Access panel and status strip for dsh-Go.
